'''''Star Wars: Union''''' is a four-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]], published between [[November]] [[1999]] and [[February]] [[2000]]. The series' plot focused on the [[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade|marriage]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
